autoReloadEnabled.title: Auto-reload open PDFs on disk change
autoReloadEnabled.description: When enabled, any open PDF viewer is automatically reloaded whenever its file changes on disk, regardless of what triggered the change (this command, an MCP/coding agent, a terminal, etc.).

autoReloadIntervalMs.title: Auto-reload poll interval (ms)
autoReloadIntervalMs.description: How often to check open files for on-disk changes, in milliseconds.

watchedFileExtensions.title: Watched file extensions
watchedFileExtensions.description: File extensions whose open viewers are automatically reloaded when the file changes on disk. Include the leading dot, e.g. ".pdf". Matching is case-insensitive. Only use this for view-only or generated files: reloading reverts the open document from disk, so any unsaved edits to a watched file would be discarded.
